summary: Track 19.22 P1 Operational Completion validated end-to-end. 29/29 lock tests + 17/17 live backend e2e tests + full Playwright UI walkthrough all pass. Employee 360° now shows 8 tabs including new Documents tab. DocumentsPane renders 7 approved records grouped by lane with structured search + lane filter (search 'termination' correctly narrows to 1). Six export package buttons all present and gated: HR/admin gets 200 PDF for all 6 packages (magic bytes '%PDF' verified, >1500 bytes each, content-type application/pdf); Safety token gets 403 on complete_file+discipline and 200 on safety.pdf. Bulk Batches page renders (list + create + lane picker + label input + Create button) and full batch lifecycle (create SAFETY batch -> upload 2 files -> pending_classification=2 -> bulk apply training_record+employee -> pending_approval=2 -> approve-all -> approved=2 -> records show approval_status=linked). Structured search filters (q, tag, date_from/to, uploader_email, department+lane, related_asset_id) all return 200 with no server errors. Zero-drift confirmed: /api/employees roster shape unchanged, no OCR/ML libs, audit ledger stays append-only.

ui_bugs.issue: PRE-EXISTING (already noted in track_19_21 report): React 'Encountered two children with the same key' warning fires repeatedly on Employee 360° timeline. Non-blocking. Fix by composing key as `${e.source}-${e.source_id}-${idx}`.

action_items: OPTIONAL/LOW: Fix duplicate-key React warning on Employee 360° timeline (carries over from Track 19.21; not caused by 19.22 changes).
critical_code_review_comments: batch_bulk_apply correctly recomputes approval_status per-record — only flips to pending_approval when BOTH employee_id AND record_type populated. Server-side mirror of UI guard.
batch_approve_all uses _actor_can_approve(actor, lane) via LANE_APPROVERS and skips records missing employee_id or record_type — matches lock test.

PACKAGE_LANE_GATE correctly restricts complete_file/training/discipline to hr+admin only; safety adds safety token; ppe_asset adds asset_admin; historical_records opens to all 4 lane owners. Verified live: Safety token 403 on complete_file+discipline, 200 on safety.pdf.
batch_upload preserves source_file_ref and computes _sha256(raw) per file; all rows land as pending_classification (unclassified before human review).

Six package titles are human-readable and match the UX spec ('Complete Employee File', 'Training Package', 'Discipline Package', 'Safety Package', 'PPE / Asset Package', 'Historical Records Package'). All generate valid ReportLab PDFs >1500 bytes.
No new ML/OCR/fuzzy-match dependencies introduced (tesseract/rapidfuzz/litellm all absent). Audit ledger remains append-only (insert_one only, no update/delete).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (8 tabs, Documents pane + search + lane filter, 6 export buttons, Batches page + create form + recent list)
